title: WATCH: Stars gather for Christopher de Leon’s 70th birthday

blocks.text: Veteran actor Christopher de Leon was treated to a birthday surprise organized by his family and celebrity friends. Amy Austria shared a video of the group singing “Happy Birthday” to de Leon, who turned 70, in an Instagram post on Saturday, Oct. 31. “Eto na! Sinurprise namin ang King Of Drama. Ang gulo ng kanta hahaha,” she wrote in the caption. De Leon’s wife, actress Sandy Andolong, also thanked the celebrities who joined the last-minute celebration. “Thank you so much to our Saturday family for the last minute surprise birthday gathering last night.
